specAmbiguitiesResolved: Deadline enters the formula through the versioned tenant risk estimate: inventory-loss ppm is selected by deadline fit (ETA = evaluated_at + quoted ETA vs current_response_deadline_at; EXPIRED or passed = DEADLINE_PASSED). A deadline change re-ranks exactly when the missed-deadline penalty exceeds the price gap (T-034 property).

Purchase/service cost is the candidate's amount (bound into its action digest and the approval maximum); the quote must corroborate it exactly (amount + tax, currency) and supplies ETA and availability. Provider score = availability (AVAILABLE 1e6, LIMITED 5e5, UNKNOWN missing, UNAVAILABLE holds the candidate).
Any eligible candidate with a missing/invalid input makes the whole plan INCOMPLETE/HELD with no ordinals (UI-SPEC: no deterministic winner while inputs are unknown).

Plan hash excludes the wall-clock evaluation time so identical inputs reproduce the same revision; approval preparation recomputes the plan and refuses (PLAN_STALE, plan invalidated) if the hash no longer reproduces.
HELD is terminal per the domain machine table (no HELD -> INVALIDATED edge); a new revision replaces it.
Plan building and approval preparation are engine-only (planning.engine, like M06 evaluation) because they run M06's engine-scoped execution gate; humans read plans.

M08 reads quotes and decisions inside its own transaction (same state rules as listIncidentQuotes / assertDecisionExecutableInTx) instead of calling pool-level APIs, to avoid holding a pooled connection while waiting for another (M07 lesson).
M08 does not move the incident state machine; PLANNING -> AWAITING_APPROVAL is left to M09 with the approval request as guard reference.
securityReview: Client-supplied amounts/currency/expiry: request schemas are strict reference-only (smuggled amount -> VALIDATION_FAILED); scope is server-derived; DB guard refuses a forged request row (UB083); client expiry can only shorten (cap 4 h and quote valid_until).
Plan-hash forgery: DIGEST_MISMATCH PLAN_HASH_MISMATCH; request FK binds (plan_id, plan_hash).

Stale-plan approval: consumer + jobs invalidate on evidence/asset/policy/quote/decision/deadline/risk/inventory change; preparation recomputes regardless (quote expiry and silently superseded decisions caught). FIXED: future-dated risk estimate now schedules revalidation at effective_at (coordinator finding).
Liveness: FIXED (0015) an invalidated revision blocked re-planning identical inputs.

Tenant isolation: foreign humans/workers get RESOURCE_UNAVAILABLE on every path; composite FKs refuse cross-tenant rows; forged event envelopes refused by consumeOnce; oversized ids refused before lookup.
Integer overflow: exact bigint arithmetic, inputs bounded to int64 / ppm / 90-day delay, result above int64 holds (OUT_OF_BOUNDS) rather than wrapping.
unresolvedRisks: Inventory-value (FOOD_AT_RISK) edits emit no event: open plans are re-checked only by the next planning event, job or approval-preparation recompute.
An APPROVABLE plan's deadline fit can drift with wall-clock time without an event; preparation recompute catches it, but the read model may show an APPROVABLE plan whose fit has since changed.
runPlanRevalidationJobs and the planning consumer (planning-revalidation.v1) must be scheduled/wired by the deployed process (M14).
recordApproval (M02) does not reference the approval request; M09 must bind approvals to a PENDING request and recheck plan state.
APPROVED/REJECTED/EXECUTING/COMPLETED transitions and POST /v1/plans/{id}:approve|:reject are M09's; the EXECUTING -> INVALIDATED + in-flight path is tested only by driving legal edges in SQL.
